capability_model.autonomous_now: Agent can inspect, research, enrich, draft, classify, send through connected approved adapters, log outcomes, and update CTOS state when policy passes.
capability_model.autonomous_if_policy_passes: Agent can execute the action without per-message approval if campaign policy, provider status, channel limits, duplicate checks, and escalation checks all pass.
capability_model.needs_integration: Agent needs a provider/API/tool connection before it can execute reliably.
capability_model.escalation_required: Wallace handles this only when trust, judgment, relationship context, provider access, legal/payment terms, or final deal authority matters.
capability_model.human_only_for_now: Human action is required because the platform or relationship context cannot be safely handled by the current adapter.
